fields.label: Workflow
fields.description: The workflow this node belongs to. A node is a record, so it can be addressed, permissioned and moved on its own.

fields.label: Node ID
fields.description: Identifies the node within its workflow. Edges point at it and a parked Run stores it as its cursor, so it must be stable.

fields.label: Node Type
fields.description: Which node type this is, named by the registry (W1). Data, not a Select: adding a node type is a registry entry, never a schema change.

fields.label: Sequence
fields.description: Authoring order. The GRAPH is the edges; this only keeps the frozen payload deterministic.

fields.label: Configuration
fields.description: This node type's own configuration, validated against the registry's declaration for it. One field instead of a column per node type's needs — a Branch's condition, a Wait's signal and mode, an Assign's mapping all lived as separate columns that every other node type carried empty.

fields.label: Edges
fields.description: Where this node goes, one row per named output the registry declares for its type.
